title: FinUnderWrite
summary: A bank-agnostic banking-statement ingestion and underwriting-feature platform that parses statements, builds canonical transaction records, and derives behavioural/financial profiles. An offline synthetic-data module generates feature-table replacements using SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers, with SingleTableMetadata detection and evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic fidelity checks.
